source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of debugging and testing (PDF 26).

blocks.text: Software debugging aur testing software development ke aham marahil hain jo software product ka maiyar aur aitbar yaqeeni banate hain. Moassar debugging aur testing developers ko tasdeeq karne mein madad deti hain ke software matlooba tafseelat poori kare, irade ke mutabiq kaam kare aur sangeen ghaltiyon se pak ho.

blocks.prompt: Debugging aur testing software product ke baare mein kya tasdeeq karti hain?
blocks.explanation: Ke yeh matlooba tafseelat poori karta, irade ke mutabiq kaam karta aur koi sangeen ghalti nahi rakhta, ta ke acha maiyar aur qabil-e-aitbar ho.

items: Debugging aur testing: maiyar aur aitbar yaqeeni banane wale aham marahil; tafseelat poori, software chalta aur sangeen ghaltiyan khatam.
